blend.inputs: only contracts with BOTH a frozen-model forecast and a valid market quote at the cutoff; the training/validation market inputs come from the frozen historical sample
blend.optimizer: same Newton settings as calibration (1-D in c)
blend.refit: intercept refit at the selected (w, lambda) on F1+F2+F3 matched rows
blend.selection: minimum F3 event-equal validation log loss over matched rows; ties within 1e-12 broken by intercept none < intercept, larger lambda, then smaller w

boundary.rule: fold parameters selected with training window ending at fold_start - horizon - (result_lag_hours + extra); every selection label verified available by the fold's first cutoff

calibration.class_count: events with at least one y=1 contract / at least one y=0 contract
calibration.objective: sum_i w_i * logloss_i + penalty, w_i = 1 / (contracts of the event in the group); event-equal (each event weighs 1)

optimizer.non_convergence: candidate form unavailable for that lambda

calibration.refit: selected form and lambda refit on F1+F2+F3 out-of-fold rows, then frozen for 2026
calibration.selection: minimum F3 event-equal validation log loss; ties within 1e-12 broken by form order identity < intercept < platt, then larger lambda

calibration_group: competition x contract family (fit separately per group; never pooled across groups)

candidates.blend: sigma(c + w*logit(p_model) + (1-w)*logit(p_market)) (w, c selected on F3)
candidates.calibrated: logistic recalibration of the frozen model (form and ridge strength selected on F3)
candidates.frozen: Phase 1 primary model (elo for two-way game winners, score model otherwise), parameters re-selected per fold for out-of-fold rows; for 2026 the sports_phase1_v2 journal forecasts verbatim
candidates.market: Kalshi mid at the forecast cutoff (last hourly candle ended by cutoff, age <= 3h, two-sided book)

capture.evidence: fresh per-run raw cache under data/cache/sports/raw_capture/<run_id>/ (Kalshi market list + ESPN scoreboard for the capture date); replayed offline by capture-replay

modes.checkpoint: CHECKPOINT: only inside the frozen window; evidence must be retrieved at or before the evidence cutoff; otherwise MISSED (never backfilled)
modes.early: EARLY_SNAPSHOT: development/smoke record for events whose T-60 cutoff is still in the future; records its actual horizon; never scored as a checkpoint forecast

capture.scope: espn_team game_winner with an Elo forecast (two-way, full game)
capture.write_once: one JSON record per (mode, event, run); existing records are never rewritten

cohorts.contract_level: test contracts whose independent payoff disagrees with Kalshi settlement are excluded from every cohort and counted per series; scored independent-source cohorts are settlement-concordant
cohorts.exploratory: independent-source series with fewer than 30 pre-test settled contracts (insufficient pre-test evidence); all-settled agreement is reported but never used for admission
cohorts.failed: independent-source series with >= 30 pre-test settled contracts and < 98% agreement: excluded from every cohort
cohorts.kalshi_settlement_only: competitions without an independent results source; labels are Kalshi settlements
cohorts.strict: independent-source series with >= 30 pre-test settled contracts and >= 98% agreement between the independent payoff and Kalshi settlement on those pre-test contracts

comparisons.rows: all scored 2026 contracts of the group

interpretation: Interval-based better/unclear/worse classes are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Beating naive forecasts and beating market reference forecasts are reported separately. RESEARCH_ONLY / NO_BET: no profitability or executable-edge claims.
labels: Kalshi settlement; Phase 1 v2 cohort and contract exclusions

no_new_quotes.field_finish: field finish (golf/F1): no new historical quotes by scope decision
no_new_quotes.player_props: player/appearance markets are not modelled (Phase 1 exclusion)
no_new_quotes.score_props: score props: no new historical quotes by scope decision
no_new_quotes.segment: segment markets (quarters/halves/innings): no new historical quotes by scope decision

quote_rule.rule: same as Phase 1: latest hourly candle with end_period_ts <= cutoff, two-sided yes book, age <= 3h; bid <= 0 or ask >= 1 is no quote

phase1.frozen: Phase 1 models, protocols and results are read-only

primary_metric: Brier (continuity with Phase 1); log loss reported alongside
sufficiency: applied to the final matched sample of each comparison (unique event clusters with every required input after all filters); below the minimum: descriptive point values only
